question: 在点数和目标形态变化时，哪些近似会损害分类稳定性？能否针对这些误差，用更合适的统计表示、精度分配和共享计算结构，获得优于现有实现的质量—成本取舍？
purpose: Bounded downward/upward feature sweep, low-count support control and order-statistic representations; no global dimension optimality claim

features.quantization: Exact rational -> ties-to-even -> INT8 [-127,127]; normalized values times127, zero for zero denominator; new output ranges analytical, no validation fitted scales
features.low_points: N=1 dispersion/contrast=0; N=2 range-normalized variance hits maximum if nonzero span; this degeneracy is disclosed and separately evaluated
features.physical_scope: Near-zero radial speed does NOT prove stationary object; normalized covariance is NOT Pearson correlation or rotation invariant; history-fused distribution is NOT instantaneous object shape

definitions.support: 1/N, quantized as round_even(127/N); N is full retained input including history, not current raw count
definitions.quantiles: For sorted int16 a and k=1,2,3, j=floor(k*(N-1)/4), r=k*(N-1)%4: Qk_times4=(4-r)*a[j]+r*a[min(j+1,N-1)]
definitions.range: support/width in [0,1], asymmetry/median_position in [-1,1]; multiply127, ties-to-even

features.cost: Quantile families need four channel sorts plus linear copies, not a single scan; reused quantiles feed all three groups; no FPGA inference

data.split: Retain audited train/validation sequence split, no new test use; validation is reused development data
data.representation: Base16 frozen proxy + independently bounded distribution descriptors; current history unchanged
data.history: Same sequence/sensor/GT track; current plus preceding six retained observations; sparse observations do not update history; no coordinate alignment or time expiry

training.reference: Reuse six frozen base16/combined23 models after full SHA/input/logit verification; do not retrain unchanged controls
training.loss: Same common class-weighted CE as software_convergence
training.sampling: Exactly same per-seed/epoch natural-coverage schedule: 50% clean, 12.5% quarter,12.5% central,25% matched natural sparse; integer remainder alternates
training.normalization_calibration: Reuse common train-only expected-mixture normalization and 16384 calibration row identities, project columns; frozen output scales; frozen QAT scales after warmup
training.initialization: Project the previous base16 initialization for retained original columns, append zero weights for new/repeated non-base columns; repeated old columns after first24 also start at zero. Same seed/hidden layers; only matched extensions preserve initial function, pruning does not.

evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired full-sequence draws; per-seed and three-seed mean; exploratory, not formal noninferiority or independent significance proof
evaluation.group_reject: On any supported condition/group: all three accuracy deltas negative and mean below -0.01
evaluation.composite: Equal average of clean, average of three quarter repeats, central_half,sparse_single,sparse_context
evaluation.A_B_guard: Also apply unchanged software_convergence promotion rule against old A/B; any failed gate keeps A main/B alternative
evaluation.composite_rule: Reduced models: mean composite loss <=0.001. Added models: mean composite gain >=0.001 over combined23, all3 seeds positive. Other quality guards unchanged. Quantile family also requires mean gain >=0.001 over support24 with all3 positive; full36 also requires >=0.001 over redundant36 with all3 positive.
evaluation.selection: Report all, including 8/12/15/17/24/28/32/36 and reused16/23. Eligible conditional candidates plus combined23 fallback: within0.001 of best mean composite, choose no-sorting first, then fewer per-point products, then smaller network, then fewer ratios; final tie higher composite. Redundant36 is explanatory only. Promotion additionally requires unchanged A/B gate. If none pass promotion retain A main/B alternative.

factorial: Quantile width/asymmetry interaction: quantile32-width28-asymmetry28+support24; mean3 paired CI, not proof of synergy
explanation.support: All original point/shape/cross/range/history groups, plus point-count degeneracy and train classwise feature distributions; fixed first error identities; same-base/different-distribution synthetic counterexamples with no class labels
explanation.interpretation: Controlled retraining association, not proof of physical causality or novel standard moments; no independent generalization claim
explanation.low_N: Report exact retained N1/N2/N3+ from raw offsets for clean/sparse views and view-adjusted count for all13; reused old failure116 rows is explicitly tracked, not a new gate or a second selection target

budget.reason: User explicitly requests wider downward/upward experiments; fixed33 new trajectories, CPU2, at most60min training; preparation30min and evaluation/package30min, no new GPU/server/hardware

stop: Exactly33 new final-epoch trajectories, no score-adaptive extra training. Numerical/data failure blocks dependent stages; timeout preserves results. Finish attribution/packaging even when no promotion succeeds.
review: Single-executor code and Python preflight; complete upstream hash closure before training. Old frozen packages preserved; new branch backup and Obsidian local mirror.
